CustomField.description: Standard: the date the donor was thanked for this gift (a card, an email, a call, a personal note). Written by the FQS Gift Acknowledgement flow when the acknowledgement is delivered — normally not set by hand. Distinct from Donor Tax Acknowledgement Date, which records when the gift left the donor's control for tax-receipt purposes, and from Tax Receipt Date, which records when the year-end tax receipt was issued.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When this donor was thanked for the gift. Usually set automatically by the FQS Gift Acknowledgement flow when the thank-you goes out. Not the tax receipt date and not the donor tax acknowledgement date.
